name: Mistral Large 4
license: Not yet published (open weights promised by end of October 2026)
archDisplay: 1.05T-total/52B-active granular MoE with a 1.6B vision encoder; 1M-token context; public preview, open weights promised by end of Oct 2026
note: Mistral's Oct 6, 2026 public preview of its largest model to date: a 1.05T-total/52B-active MoE with a 1.6B vision encoder and 1M context, trained on 3,800 Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's own European datacenters. The preview API is priced at $1.36/$4.18 per Mtok and weights are promised by the end of October, so no license or Hugging Face repo exists yet. Mistral reports DeepSWE v1.1 61.7%, SWE-Atlas-QnA 59.4%, Terminal-Bench 4 28.3% and AA-Briefcase 1,393 Elo, plus strong cyber numbers (Cybench 93%). Most launch figures appear only in prose; the charts are images.

results.notes: DeepSWE v1.1, launch post prose ("scoring 61.7% on DeepSWE v1.1"); preview checkpoint, effort unstated.
"59.4% on SWE-Atlas-QnA" — assumed to be SWE-Atlas Codebase QnA (precedent muse-spark-1-3). Flag if the caller wants to confirm the subset.
AA-Briefcase Elo, "it reaches 1,393 Elo"; version (v1 vs v1.1) not stated.
